minigames.name: DNS Cutover
minigames.description: Arrange the steps of a traffic cutover in the order they must be performed so no request lands on a dead target during the transition.

minigames.name: Restore Drill
minigames.description: Order the restore procedure correctly — verify integrity before promoting, promote before cutting over — to prove the runbook works under pressure.

minigames.name: Certificate Chain
minigames.description: Assemble the certificate chain from leaf to root in the exact order a TLS client validates it, so the handshake completes without errors.

minigames.name: YAML Manifest
minigames.description: Fill in the missing fields of a deployment manifest — replica count, resource limits, image tag — that actually govern capacity and rollout behavior.

minigames.name: Cache Key Match
minigames.description: Write the key pattern that invalidates exactly the stale entries you meant to clear, without nuking unrelated hot data and causing unnecessary misses.

minigames.name: IAM Policy
minigames.description: Complete the policy document to grant least-privilege access — narrow enough to block over-reach, broad enough that the calling service still functions.

minigames.name: Incident Comms
minigames.description: Draft the missing fields of a status-page update that informs affected users without speculating beyond what has been confirmed.

minigames.name: Threshold Tuning
minigames.description: Set a numeric trigger point — scale threshold, failover timeout, rate limit, alert rule, or sampling rate — that fires before damage occurs but not on routine noise, drilling the skill of reading a signal and picking a value that is tight enough to be useful yet loose enough to avoid constant false positives.

minigames.name: Resource Sizing
minigames.description: Size an instance or connection pool against measured load data rather than guessing, hitting the target range that handles current traffic without wasting money on idle capacity.

minigames.name: Queue Triage
minigames.description: Set the worker count high enough to drain a backlog at the current arrival rate without over-provisioning consumers that sit idle once the queue is clear.

minigames.name: Capacity Planning
minigames.description: Choose the service tier whose headroom matches projected growth so the architecture is neither over-provisioned today nor underpowered in the next quarter.

minigames.name: Topology Puzzle
minigames.description: Wire the architecture components so redundancy spans availability zones or regions, ensuring a single zone or region failure does not take the service down.

minigames.name: Log Triage
minigames.description: Scan a log tail and select exactly the lines that prove the root cause of the current failure, distinguishing signal from surrounding noise and correlation-only noise.

minigames.name: Query Plan
minigames.description: Reads a query plan to find why it is slow, then picks the change — index, rewrite, or join order — that fixes the bottleneck without introducing a new one.

minigames.name: Diff Review
minigames.description: Read the deploy history and identify the specific change that introduced the regression, distinguishing the culprit diff from unrelated commits deployed in the same window.
